Pull request description:

This change adds retry with exponential backoff to the webhook sender. Previously a single failed delivery was dropped silently. Now we retry up to five times, doubling the wait from one second, and record each attempt in the delivery log.

Testing: I added unit tests for the backoff schedule and for the give-up path after the fifth attempt. All existing tests pass locally and in CI. I also ran the sender against a local mock endpoint that fails the first three calls and confirmed the fourth call succeeds and is logged.

Risk: the retry loop runs in the background worker, so request latency for callers is unchanged.

Pull request description:

This change replaces the hand-written date parsing in the reporting module with the standard library parser. The old parser accepted several ambiguous formats and we have had confusion about day and month order in the past. The new code is shorter and easier to read, and it removes about two hundred lines. I also renamed a few helper functions for clarity and moved the constants into their own file.

I have not had time to write or run any tests for this yet, and CI has not run on it. I would like early feedback on the direction before I continue.
